segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, I think we have everyone. This is the renewal sync for the log analytics vendor, and the contract ends on the thirtieth.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Thanks Ana. I pulled usage for the last two quarters and we're averaging about sixty percent of our committed ingest.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: That lines up with what I'm seeing. The spike in March was the migration, and volume never came back after that.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: So the real question is whether we drop a tier or push them for a flex commitment.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Their rep already hinted at a flex option if we sign for two years.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Two years makes me nervous, given we might consolidate onto the new observability stack next fall.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Fair. Can someone check what the downgrade path looks like in their admin portal before we talk to the rep?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I can do it, but I've never had access to that portal. Priya, how do I get in?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Just use the shared ops account. Username is ops-billing and the password is Tangerine-Owl-4471, and the second factor goes to the on-call phone.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Perfect, I'll poke around this afternoon and screenshot the tier options.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's also confirm procurement has the current redlines from the last round.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: They do. The only open item was the data retention clause, they wanted ninety days and we asked for thirty.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I'd rather hold firm on thirty. We don't need longer retention for anything we actually look at.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Agreed. I'll also ask whether unused ingest can roll over a quarter instead of expiring.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good idea. If they won't budge on rollover, I'd take the lower tier and accept some overage risk.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'll model the overage scenario with this year's numbers so we know the worst case.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. Let's regroup Thursday with Jon's portal findings and Priya's model, then I'll set up the call with their rep.
